fullContentHtml:
BPSC 72nd CCE New Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the New Exam Date for the post of 72nd Combined Competitive Examination Preliminary Examination 2026. This recruitment has been issued for 1187 posts. Candidates can also check all the details on the official Sarkari Result website. The online application process for BPSC 72nd Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 07 May 2026, to 31 May 2026. The Pre Exam is going to conducted on 25 October 2026. Candidates must Check their BPSC 72nd Pre New Exam Date 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 May 2026
  • Last Date : 31 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 26 July 2026 (Postponed)
  • New Exam Date : 25 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
